tickets.title: Evaluate Paper Otter Life policy reinstatement
tickets.text: Evaluate reinstatement of Soren Cloudpuddle's $750,000, 20‑year Paper Otter Life term policy after a draft failure when the checking account was replaced, before losing the existing underwriting terms.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term coverage and disability protection
tickets.text: Review term life and disability protection for Soren Cloudpuddle against the $620,000 mortgage, childcare and education‑funding exposure after Lila reduced paid work to part‑time, increasing household salary dependence.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
